Situation Report — Day 27 (last 2 hrs)

Strikes ongoing: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran continue; Iran, Hezbollah and allied groups launched missiles/drones toward Israel — multiple interceptions reported.
  • Frontlines: US/Israeli strikes persist. IDF reports a large strike yesterday: 50+ aircraft hit Iranian nuclear-weapons program and production sites across three areas.
  • Iranian & proxy attacks: Houthis launched a missile toward Israel (IDF intercepted). Drone/rocket activity from Iran and proxies continues. Prince Sultan (Saudi) attacked — dozens of US troops wounded; some aircraft damaged.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah active daily. IDF officers and soldiers wounded in southern Lebanon skirmishes.
  • Regional strikes & infrastructure: Reported attack/fire at Kuwait’s Al-Zour port. Drone strike injured one at Salalah port, Oman. Booster from an Iranian ballistic missile fell in West Bank village.
  • Diplomacy & pause: Trump announced a second 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), claiming Iran requested talks; Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. First 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — pause fragile.
  • Strategic moves: Iran allows Hormuz passage for Russia/India/China while blocking others. Iran and Iraq airports closed; regional flight disruption.
  • Intel/tactical notes: Reports of US actions to disable Iranian missile launchers inside Iran. Large multi-aircraft targeting of nuclear sites marks intensified targeting.
  • 🟢 Good News: Aerial defenses intercepted multiple incoming missiles/drones (including Yemen launch). Civilian casualties so far limited in recent strikes.
Threat assessment: Escalating

  • התקפות איראניות ומוקדמות: החות'ים שיגרו טיל לעבר ישראל — יורט (דיווח צה"ל). פעילות רחפנים/רטשיות מאיראן ופרוקסים נמשכת. עמדת בסיס פרינס סולטן בסעודיה נפגעה; רופסי אמריקאים נפגעו ועקב נזק לכלי טיס.
  • גבול צפון: חיזבאללה פעיל מדי יום. קצינים וחיילים של צה"ל נפגעו בעימותים בדרום לבנון.
  • התקפות אזוריות ותשתיות: דיווח על תקיפה ושריפה בנמל אל-זוור בכווית. פגיעה בנמל סלאלה בעומאן — נפצע אחד. דחיל משגר טיל איראני נמצא בכפר ביהודה ושומרון.
  • דיפלומטיה והפסקה: טראמפ הכריז על הפסקת צעדי אנרגיה שנייה ל-10 ימים (עד 6.4.2026 20:00 ET), טוען שביקשה איראן; איראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. פקיסטן מתווכת. ההפסקה הראשונה (23.3) הופרה בתוך שעות בהפצצות על אספהאן וח'ורמסחר - הפסקה רעועה.
  • מהלכים אסטרטגיים: איראן פתחה מעבר הורמוז לרוסיה, הודו וסין וחוסמת אחרים. נמלי תעופה באיראן ועיראק סגורים; הפרעות לטיסות אזוריות.
  • מודיעין וטקטיקה: דיווחים על פעולות אמריקאיות לנטרול משגרי טילים בשטח איראני. תקיפה רב-מטוסית של אתרי גרעין מצביעה על העלאת רמת הדיוק והיעדים.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: מערכות ההגנה האווירית יירטו מספר שיגורים (כולל מהחוף התימני). עד כה נפגעים אזרחיים מוגבלים.

Day 27 — Situation Report

  • Active: Missile from Yemen intercepted over Israel; US/Israeli airstrikes struck Iranian nuclear/weapons production sites yesterday (IDF: 50+ aircraft).

Air campaign

  • IDF/US strikes hit multiple Iranian facilities including claims against nuclear/uranium production sites and weapons production areas.
  • U.S. troops at Prince Sultan Air Base hit in recent Iranian strikes; reports say 12 wounded, other sources report higher totals.
  • Iranian airports closed; commercial flights reduced. Flight-scan showed large drop in regional traffic.

Northern border (Hezbollah)

  • Daily exchanges continue. Anti-tank fire in southern Lebanon severely wounded an IDF officer; additional casualties reported.
  • Hezbollah missile/rocket fire continues to target northern Israel and IDF positions.

Maritime / Gulf

  • Iran allows Hormuz passage to Russia, China, India; blocks other nations' shipping.
  • Attacks reported on Gulf ports: Al-Zour (Kuwait) hit; drone strike at Salalah (Oman) injured one; falling debris injured five near KIZAD (Abu Dhabi).

Other incidents

  • Booster stage of an Iranian ballistic missile landed in a West Bank village.
  • Iran published names from earlier Beirut hotel strike; tensions around investigator/claims rising.

Diplomacy / mediation

  • Trump announced a second 10-day pause on energy-targeting strikes (deadline Apr 6, 20:00 ET), claiming talks. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Russian and Iranian FMs discussed a possible settlement pathway. Reports say some US weapons meant for Ukraine will be redirected to the Middle East.
  • 🟢 Good News: Multiple incoming missile/drone threats intercepted today. A temporary pause on energy strikes was announced.

Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • Regional & Maritime: Iran opened Strait of Hormuz to “friendly” nations (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Attacks reported on Al-Zour port (Kuwait) and Salalah port (Oman). Airports in Iran and Iraq reported closed.
  • US / Coalition: Multiple incidents at Prince Sultan Air Base. AP/NYT: 12+ US troops injured in recent Iranian attacks; dozens wounded reported over the week. US reportedly redirecting some weapons stocks to Middle East.
  • Tactical notes: Massed strike with 50+ jets is significant scale against Iranian WMD-related infrastructure. Air defenses successfully intercepted cross-border missile threats today.
  • 🟢 Good News: Missile from Yemen intercepted. Pakistan mediation active. No large-scale territorial incursions reported today.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
